title: RECESS
tagline: The ultimate digital school playground. Three classic mini-games in one: Tic-Tac-Toe, Rock Paper Scissors, and Connect Four — all on a nostalgic school desk.

roles.name: Schoolyard Buddy
roles.description: Join the classroom lobby, chat on desks, create private room codes, and jump into mini-games!

multiplayer.notes: Authoritative game server with room codes, matchmaking queues, secret roles, and smart schoolyard bots.
